title: Cloud Migration Prerequisites for Dynamics SL

facts.text: Destination must have Business Central online tenant with at least one SUPER permission user
Must install Intelligent Cloud Base, Dynamics SL Intelligent Cloud, and related apps with latest updates
User performing migration needs SUPER permissions and Microsoft admin center admin role, or delegated admin with permission grant
Source database must be Dynamics SL 2015 or later on SQL Server 2016 SP1 or later with compatibility level 130 or higher
SQL Server must have TCP/IP enabled and configured for SQL Server authentication with sysadmin and db_owner roles
Self-hosted integration runtime machine required for on-premises local databases
Migration currently only supported for United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Australia markets
